species.name: Cohort Capitulation Reversal (COILED / STAR / C2)
species.mechanism: Sustained sector-cohort liquidation exhausts the marginal seller. When ≥40% of a sector's constituents are in multi-timeframe washout, the remaining sellers are structural longs rather than momentum players — the cohort's next buyer is rotation capital entering a sector that has already priced the damage. STAR (multi-TF bullish divergence) provides stop relief only WITH cohort context; C2 (union trigger) widens recall from 12.4 to 14.2 and shortens lead from 6d to 3d.

species.name: Failed breakout (trapped-buyer supply)
species.mechanism: A new-high breakout that closes back below the breakout level traps late buyers who chased the print; their supply overhang suppresses subsequent rally attempts. The failed-breakout pattern identifies names whose breakout has reversed intrabar or within 1-3 sessions, leaving the majority of late entrants underwater. This is a top/entry-veto-shaped context for de-escalation or new-position avoidance — NOT a short-selling signal. The supply overhang typically resolves as: (a) time washout (late buyers capitulate) or (b) re-test of the breakout level on improved breadth. Mechanism link: the Wave-5 retest_hold study confirmed that a retest of the prior high WITHOUT breakout failure predicts continuation; the complement (WITH failure) predicts elevated drawdown risk.

evidence_stack.condition: Breakout-then-close-below: price prints a new 52-week high intraday or at open, then closes below the prior high on the same or next 1-3 sessions
Volume confirmation: failed breakout accompanied by above-average volume (trapped-buyer supply is larger on high volume)
Not a short-sell signal: S14 is a VETO on new long entries and a context for de-escalation; no short position or rank change is implied

rejection_rules.rule: No short-sell signals permitted: S14 is entry-veto shaped; any use as a short or underweight signal is a scope violation
Index-breakout context: broad-market new highs suppress the per-name failed-breakout mechanism — do not fire in strong bull-tape regimes without regime gating
Stale-breakout exclusion: if the 52-week high was set >60 trading days prior, the trapped-buyer supply has likely been absorbed; the pattern is invalid for new signals

Kill criteria: median forward return NOT below control OR effect driven by single regime.
